release_notes:
Fix: cross-site Zelle/Wise mailbox race could credit the wrong customer

The amount-only fallback pass ignored the deposit's memo entirely, so a deposit
whose memo named a specific invoice or username not found on this site (because
it belonged to a sibling site sharing the same mailbox/account) could still be
grabbed by amount alone and credited to an unrelated customer here.

The fallback now skips any deposit whose memo contains an extractable reference
at all, even one that doesn't resolve locally -- only genuinely blank memos are
still eligible for amount-only matching. A referenced deposit is left unclaimed
for the correct site (or a human) to match instead of being guessed at.
